```json
{"tests": [{"name": "Happy Path", "given": "No arguments provided", "expect": "usage: hello [NAME]", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}]}
```

```go
package cli

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestFormatUsageError(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		want     string
	}{
		{
			name: "Happy Path",
			want: "usage: hello [NAME]",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got := formatUsageError()
			if got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("formatUsageError() = %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
```
